messages:
noah-w: Hey team, need to add my stepchild to medical after custody finalized. Placement date 2026-11-03. SSN and birth cert are on the way from the county, ETA ~2 weeks. Can we provision coverage now and what docs are required? Also worried about payroll hitting a big retro deduction 

amy-peopleops: Congrats Noah. Yes we can provision pending docs for a custody QLE. Please upload any court order or custody agreement and a photo ID for the child when you have it. We set provisional coverage to the custody date and you have 60 days to provide final docs (SSN/birth cert). 

noah-w: Good to hear. If we start coverage 11/03 will payroll take all premiums retro in the next paycheck? That could be rough this month.

payroll: We can split retro premium across two subsequent pay runs if needed. Tell us which pay dates you'd like the split over, or we can default to splitting evenly across the next 2 cycles. Also confirm whether you want deductions taken as employee-only or family until dependent is fully verified.

noah-w: Please split across next 2 cycles and keep employee+child rate. My next pay dates are 11/09 and 11/23.

benefits-bot: :paperclip: Ticket B-33022 created "Stepchild provisional add for noah-w". Attach custody order and later SSN to this ticket.

amy-peopleops: Received. Setting provisional effective date 2026-11-03. Payroll: please prorate premiums for the period and split retro across 11/09 and 11/23 as requested. I will mark the ticket and follow up if carrier needs extra verification.

payroll: Noted. We'll prorate and split the retro deduction across 11/09 and 11/23 runs and update deductions to employee+child.

karen-mgr: Thanks for coordinating — LMK if Noah needs any short-term cash advance options from People Ops given the timing.

noah-w: Appreciate it, will upload custody order to the ticket today. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
